name: php-wasm-fibers
description: Making PHP Fibers work in the in-browser php-wasm build, and closing the other gaps
_aboutScripts: test = check:prototype + probe:local, and needs a build (npm run build:php) to exist first. probe:published is deliberately excluded: it reproduces the defects against the shipped package and therefore exits non-zero on purpose, which is the opposite of a test result.
